stem: Which of these best describes Pavel’s internal conflict in the story?

options.label: A
options.text: He is unhappy about the cost of his ticket.

options.label: B
options.text: A man places him on the other side of the ship.

options.label: C
options.text: A man stands between him and the soup pot.

options.label: D
options.text: He is not prepared for the misery of the voyage to America.
